meta.name: hqq-quantization
meta.description: Half-Quadratic Quantization for LLMs without calibration data. Use when quantizing models to 4/3/2-bit precision without needing calibration datasets, for fast quantization workflows, or when deploying with vLLM or HuggingFace Transformers.

copy.tagline: 无需校准数据即可量化大语言模型至4/3/2比特精度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在无校准数据场景下快速量化LLM并部署到vLLM或Transformers
copy.tagline_en: Quantize LLMs to 4/3/2-bit precision without calibration data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly quantize LLMs without calibration data and deploy with vLLM or Transformers

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你把大型语言模型（如 Llama）的权重压缩到 4/3/2/1 位精度，无需校准数据，并支持在 vLLM 或 HuggingFace Transformers 中部署。
howto.when: 当你需要量化模型（如将模型从 16 位压缩到 4 位），且没有校准数据集时触发。也适用于快速量化或部署到 vLLM 等场景。

say.text: 用 HQQ 把 Llama-3.1-8B 量化到 4 位。
say.note: Claude 会生成量化代码并执行。

say.text: 帮我用 HQQ 量化模型并保存到本地。
say.note: Claude 会生成保存量化模型的代码。

say.text: 用 HQQ 和 LoRA 微调一个 4 位量化模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成 PEFT 微调代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you compress large language models (e.g., Llama) to 4/3/2/1-bit precision without calibration data, and supports deployment with vLLM or HuggingFace Transformers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to quantize a model (e.g., from 16-bit to 4-bit) without calibration datasets, or for fast quantization workflows and deployment with vLLM or HuggingFace Transformers.

say_en.note: Claude will generate and run quantization code.

say_en.text: Help me quantize a model with HQQ and save it locally.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code to save the quantized model.

say_en.text: Fine-tune a 4-bit quantized model with HQQ and LoRA.
say_en.note: Claude will generate PEFT fine-tuning code.
